content: Agent Builder in Microsoft Foundry Toolkit for Visual Studio Code supports prompt agents that use the Microsoft Copilot harness in public preview. Developers can configure tools and skills, edit local YAML definitions, deploy changes to Foundry, and run deployed agent versions from VS Code. Foundry manages the harness and execution environment for supported multi-step workflows involving tools, skills, files, and commands. Learn more.
